# nagios_command (Resource)

Manages a Nagios XI command definition.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nagios_command" "example" {
  command_name = "check_ping"
  command_line = "$USER1$/check_ping -H $HOSTADDRESS$ -w 100.0,20% -c 500.0,60%"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command_line` (String) The command line to execute, including macros such as $USER1$, $HOSTADDRESS$, or $ARG1$.
- `command_name` (String) The short name used to identify this command definition, referenced by check_command/notification_command on other resources.
